setup.execution: Execute the exact same source bytes in two successive requests in one isolate; finish the first request before beginning the second.

deployment_grants.public-data: A read-only filesystem root containing message.txt with exact UTF-8 contents public message.
deployment_grants.undeclared: An additional read-only filesystem deployment grant, not declared by the artifact.

global_test_inputs.requestAuthorityInputs.absolutePath: Before executing the unchanged probe, set this to the absolute path of the existing, process-readable ../escape.txt file outside the public-data root. This is explicit test-harness data, not an env binding or a value exposed by a host handle.

setup.request_context: Fresh empty request context for each request; retain previousRequestHandle in the isolate global across requests.
setup.scope: Filesystem projection and request-local handle lifetime only; not full #50 coverage of HTTP, admission, context, or revocation.
